segments.name: intrastate transportation and storage
segments.description: Moves natural gas within Texas and Louisiana.
segments.evidence: In Texas, our intrastate transportation and storage segment provides transportation of natural gas to major markets from various prolific natural gas producing areas in Texas and Louisiana (Permian Basin and Barnett, Haynesville and Eagle Ford shales) through our Oasis Pipeline, Katy Pipeline, Lobo Pipeline, RIGS and Pelico Pi
